user.title: Add SOLIX Extras
user.description: Select a battery already configured in Anker SOLIX Official. Extras adds sensors and controls to its existing device.

error.battery_unavailable: The selected official battery is no longer available. Check that it is enabled and loaded, then try again.
error.cannot_read_temperature: Could not read the battery temperature. Check the battery connection and that its firmware exposes input register 10156.

abort.already_configured: Extras is already configured for this battery.
abort.no_official_batteries: No supported batteries are ready in Anker SOLIX Official. Install and configure the official integration first, and make sure its battery device is enabled and available.

reserve_unavailable.message: Backup reserve is unavailable for this battery.

reserve_write_failed.message: Could not confirm the backup reserve change. Check the battery connection and current setting.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: Choose how often Extras reads the battery over Modbus. Enter a whole number of seconds, at least 1. The default is 60 seconds.
